_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The record-screen shortcut requests the screen in its own turn, before a delayed draft, and blocks duplicates. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. To "open the recording palette", every time a step says so: press_key "k" with modifier "Control", wait for the command palette input (".command-palette-input") to be visible, and fill it with "Record audio" (all three, every time). "The palette item X" is the command palette item whose title is exactly X; select it with '.command-palette-item[data-test-title="X"]' (the page keeps that attribute equal to the item's title, so "Record audio" does not match "Record audio and screen"). The server's answers to the browser's draft creations (POST /api/conversations/draft) are held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftStarted" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft, and call "draftRequests" counts the draft creations the browser sent. window.__displayRequestsAtDraft is what window.__recordingMock.displayRequests was when the page sent its draft creation. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. Press the record-screen shortcut.
3. Call "draftStarted" until it returns "true".
4. window.__displayRequestsAtDraft must be 1, and window.__recordingMock.displayRequests and window.__recordingMock.synchronousDisplayRequests must both be 1.
5. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen".
6. Eval "(m => ({microphone: m.microphoneRequests, starts: m.recorderStarts}))(window.__recordingMock)" should become exactly {"microphone":1,"starts":1}.
7. Open the recording palette. There must be no palette item "Record audio" and no palette item "Record audio and screen" (both counts 0). Press Escape.
8. Press the record-audio shortcut, then the record-screen shortcut.
9. Call "draftRequests" must return "1", and window.__recordingMock.displayRequests must still be 1.
10. Call "releaseDraft".
11. The recording panel should have data-mode "screen", and eval "(m => ({display: m.displayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests, starts: m.recorderStarts}))(window.__recordingMock)" should become exactly {"display":1,"microphone":1,"starts":1}.
12. Press the record-audio shortcut, then the record-screen shortcut. The same eval must still return exactly {"display":1,"microphone":1,"starts":1}.
13. Click the cancel button.
